task.description: Implement ISS-0180 fix (GH #511): every check in the test-environment checklist must verify the database the tests actually use. Fix the condition, not the detector.
acceptance_criteria: C3 migrates the same database C4 verifies
A test database behind migrations/ causes C3 itself to FAIL, not only C4
C3 remedy distinguishes migration failure from wrong-database targeting
Bug proven present pre-fix and gone post-fix with pasted output
zig build test-env-verify exits 0 in the correct configuration
No check deleted, relaxed, or silenced

result.summary: Added C0 preflight (resolves+prints BPM_DB_URL/BPM_TEST_DB_URL redacted; FAILs on missing BPM_TEST_DB_URL or dev==test). C3 now runs zig build migrate with BPM_DB_URL overridden to BPM_TEST_DB_URL in the child env only, then asserts the test DB ledger count == migrations/*.sql count (exit 0 alone is insufficient: migrate exits 0 when its target is already current, which is what caused the false green). C3 failure detail/remedy now name the DB and distinguish genuine migration failure from incomplete ledger. C1 resolves the container via COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME (was hardcoded r-co-db_test-1, which fell through to a substring filter matching any workspace) and confirms it publishes BPM_TEST_DB_URL's port. C7 keeps bench.zig precedence but names the resolved URL. Detail printed on PASS too. C4 untouched. Guide section 3 and anti-patterns.md updated.

evidence.pre_fix_repro: dev 108/108, test 107/108 -> [PASS] C3, [FAIL] C4, exit 1 (false green on C3)
evidence.post_fix_same_condition: C3 migrated test DB, reported 108/108 on :5453, all checks PASS, exit 0
evidence.c3_failure_path_reachable: phantom ledger row (109 vs 108) -> [FAIL] C3 + [FAIL] C4, exit 1
evidence.c1_failure_path: stale BPM_TEST_DB_URL port 5434 vs r-co-2 container -> FAIL
